title: Parser pipeline components
caption: SQL text passes through the scanner and grammar with no catalog access, then analyze.c looks names up in the catalogs and the rewriter applies view rules before the planner.

title: One SELECT through parsing
caption: Follow SELECT price FROM items from the raw text to a checked Query tree, noticing that the FROM clause is read before the column name is resolved.

badges.meaning: scan.l splits the text into tokens
transformFromClause opens items and fills the namespace
colNameToVar turns the name price into a Var
the rewritten Query goes to the planner

title: Anatomy of a Query tree
caption: A Query holds a range table, a join tree and a target list, and each Var points back to a range table entry by number.

badges.meaning: Query is the top struct, defined in parsenodes.h
rtable lists the tables the statement reads
jointree holds FROM and the WHERE quals
Var.varno points at a range table entry
